爱莎贝儿新品发布-148CM-L 粉肤 AHR028 西野雅代Nishino Masayo-让天空降下甘露的精灵
古林之巅，那位金发如流金瀑布的精灵现身了。
无数金色藤蔓自她雪白的肩头、纤细的腰肢、修长的双腿缠绕而上，像活物般缓缓收紧，叶尖渗出细小的血珠。
她仰起脸，金发在风中狂乱飞舞，碧眸里藏着冷冽的光亮。轻启朱唇，声音低沉而破碎。
“我祈求……求您降下甘露。”
天空回应她的请求，只是降落在她身上的甘露带着审判的重量——每一滴都冰冷、锋利，刺痛着她的灵魂。
藤蔓越收越紧，她却静静微笑，血与露交融，顺着金发滑落。
万物静籁，只余她被惩罚的身影……

Elsa Babe New Doll Release-148CM-L Pink AHR028 Nishino Masayo-The Fairy Who Sends Dew from the Sky
Atop the ancient forest, the fairy with golden hair like a cascading waterfall appeared.
Countless golden vines coiled around her snow-white shoulders, slender waist, and long legs, slowly tightening as if they were alive, tiny beads of blood seeping from the tips of the leaves.
She tilted her head back, her golden hair flying wildly in the wind, her emerald eyes holding a cold light. She parted her lips slightly, her voice low and broken.
"I beg... I beg you to send down dew."
The sky answered her plea, but the dew that fell upon her carried the weight of judgment—each drop was cold, sharp, and piercing her soul.
The vines tightened further, yet she smiled quietly, blood and dew mingling, sliding down her golden hair.
Everything was silent, except for her punished figure...
